correctness.rationale: Each polytope vertex is uniquely encoded by the winning coordinate of every edge and cyclic triple. Cyclic edge signs and binary valley-chord choices enumerate all formal assignments; feasibility is exactly acyclicity of the strict comparison digraph. Deleting valleys reduces the comparison graph to an oriented cyclic multigraph, so precisely the two independent-set classes of sign words produce one forbidden orientation each. Transfer-matrix traces yield the exact expression for every n≥4. Hypergraphic normal-cone order covers give simplicity, the explicit all-n≥5 witness has n covers in dimension n−1, and an exhaustive 24-permutation check covers n=4. Exact-integer replay corroborates n=4..12 but is not used to infer the all-n statement. Edge cases n=4 and cyclic alternating sign words are handled explicitly.
